question:
What is the mean of the median and the mode of the data:

19, 20, 14, 15, 19, 16, 17, 15,14, 13, 18, 19, 17, 13
solution:
**Given:**

Data: 19, 20, 14, 15, 19, 16, 17, 15,14, 13, 18, 19, 17, 13

**Concepts used:**

Mean = Arithmetic average of the data. 

Mode = It is an observation that occurs highest number of times.

Median = It is the middle observation. 

**Calculation:**

By arranging the data in ascending order, we get

13, 13, 14, 14, 15, 15, 16, 17, 17, 18, 19, 19, 19, 20

Mode = 19 

Out of 14 observations, middle value will be the average of 7th and 8th value.

Median = (16 + 17)/2 = 16.5 

**∴ Mean of median and mode = (16.5 + 19)/2 = 17.75**
